verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a vague homepage claim that users can 'describe what you want in plain text and let Bento's powerful AI build it for you' (bento-docs-10). It does not say the AI drafts subject lines or email copy, or that it runs inside the email composer. The MCP server can create broadcasts, but that is an external assistant, not built-in composer AI, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented in-composer AI for drafting and refining subject lines, generating copy from a brief, editing or refining existing copy, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
